title: Curiosity needs a place that is not a deliverable
method: A conceptual sequence for the reflection exercise in this essay. The steps describe a possible practice, not a measured causal effect or a universal rule.
alt: Concept diagram: Notice a question — Choose something worth understanding before justifying it.; Bound the encounter — Use a small mechanism, input, or session.; Follow a useful clue — Allow the original question to become more precise.; Preserve a fragment — Record what changed and whether to return..
